visible.title: Streamlit is loading autometically reloading  if deployed as a service in k8 cluster
visible.body:
### Checklist

### Summary

I am using creating. a stream lit app with langchain and langgraph. 
the app is running fine locally whereas when I am deploying the same code base  in K8s cluster behind the gatekeeper,it is running whereas randomly  its failing in lang graph nodes execution . 

I t is showing the graph node executions happening in the logs wheres on UI its not rendering anything on UI it refresh the page automatically  and post that it stop the running status on UI. 

Also I have observed that if we access the url from different browser it behave similarly .

Please suggest if anyone is facing the similar issue.

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("\n main function\n")

    if 'userinput' not in st.session_state:
            st.session_state.userinput = None
    st.session_state.app_start = "run"
    start_app()
```

### Steps To Reproduce

### Expected Behavior

it should work in similar way as its working in local.

### Current Behavior

No error message  

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.39
- Python version:3.9
- Operating System:RHEL
- Browser: Chrome

### Additional Information

gold.summary: In k8s behind gatekeeper, app randomly refreshes and loses output during long langgraph runs.
acceptable_next_steps: Ask about replicas/affinity and proxy timeouts; point to session-affinity docs
gold.reference: Maintainer asked about replicas/sticky sessions; closed inactive.
